user.description: User preferences and constraints — never expire automatically

feedback.description: Feedback memories — refresh TTL on access, otherwise expire after 90 days

project.description: Project memories — expire after project end date (set in lifecycle.expires_at)

reference.description: External references — expire after 180 days unless refreshed

session.description: Ephemeral session summaries — short TTL, should be promoted or discarded

task.description: Task context — expires after task completion or 30 days
